text.en:
Section four of Act Numbered Three thousand and sixty-five is hereby amended to read as
"Section 4. The tax established by this Act shall be in force and effect and be collected only upon business
transacted from the date of the approval of this Act until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and
twenty-five."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 27, 1924.
